---
title: "Recent and Upcoming Talks"
listing:
  id: listings
  contents: 
    - talks.yaml
  sort: "date desc"
  type: table
  page-size: 10
page-layout: full
---


:::{listings}
:::

<style>
#listing-listings td.listing-title-cell {
  vertical-align: top;
}
#listing-listings td.listing-title-cell[rowspan]:not([rowspan="1"]) {
  vertical-align: middle;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--bs-secondary, #ccc);
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  function markTitleCells() {
    // One-time setup: tag each row's title <td> so it can be found again
    // after cells get removed/reinserted by the merge pass below.
    document.querySelectorAll('#listing-listings tbody.list > tr').forEach(function (row) {
      const span = row.querySelector('.listing-title');
      if (!span) return;
      const td = span.closest('td');
      if (!td) return;
      td.classList.add('listing-title-cell');
      if (row.dataset.titleText === undefined) {
        row.dataset.titleText = span.textContent;
        row.dataset.titleIndex = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(row.children, td);
      }
    });
  }

  function restoreTitleCell(row) {
    // Re-insert a plain, unspanned title cell if a previous merge removed it.
    if (row.querySelector(':scope > td.listing-title-cell')) return;
    const td = document.createElement('td');
    td.className = 'listing-title-cell';
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'listing-title';
    span.textContent = row.dataset.titleText || '';
    td.appendChild(span);
    const index = parseInt(row.dataset.titleIndex, 10) || 0;
    row.insertBefore(td, row.children[index] || null);
  }

  function applyTitleMerge() {
    const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#listing-listings tbody.list > tr'));

    // Reset every row to its own unspanned title cell first, so grouping
    // is recomputed cleanly on every sort/filter/search event.
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      restoreTitleCell(row);
      row.querySelector(':scope > td.listing-title-cell').rowSpan = 1;
    });

    let group = [];
    function flushGroup() {
      if (group.length > 1) {
        const head = group[0];
        head.querySelector(':scope > td.listing-title-cell').rowSpan = group.length;
        group.slice(1).forEach(function (row) {
          row.querySelector(':scope > td.listing-title-cell').remove();
        });
      }
      group = [];
    }

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      if (row.style.display === 'none') return; // filtered out, ignore for grouping
      const title = row.dataset.titleText;
      const groupTitle = group.length ? group[0].dataset.titleText : null;
      if (group.length && title !== groupTitle) flushGroup();
      group.push(row);
    });
    flushGroup();
  }

  function waitForListInstance() {
    const list = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-listings'];
    if (list) {
      markTitleCells();
      applyTitleMerge();
      list.on('updated', applyTitleMerge);
    } else {
      setTimeout(waitForListInstance, 50);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', waitForListInstance);
})();
</script>
